name: Clay

pitch_detail.notes: Thin, funky climbing off the ground leads to a lieback past two bolts to a crack and a stance under a roof; crack and face climbing past jugs and stemming to a tricky crux finish.
Slab up to 'the Beach'; protected by 4 bolts and small finger-sized cams.

gear: Small finger-sized cams for pitch 2, alongside its 4 bolts
Two bolts protect the lieback on pitch 1
